$comment: Panel refresh-safety profiles. min_safe_s = ceil(full_refresh_ms * (100 + safety_margin_pct) / 100 / 1000) + min_dwell_s. effective = max(requested, min_safe_s). Unknown profiles use fallback_s. layout = shared layout file; palette = colours the panel can show (K black, W white, R red, Y yellow); build = firmware build id (flash.bat COMx <build>); driver = GxEPD2 class. verified = timing confirmed on real hardware. palette_roles maps semantic colours (accent bars/titles, neg losses/errors, rule separators, flag badge background/foreground) to each palette. module = short name shown when choosing a module (Register device, simulator, flashing wizard).
